records.name: DOEACC / NIELIT
records.description: National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology (NIELIT), formerly DOEACC, is an autonomous body under the Ministry of Electronics and IT offering IT training and certification programs across India. It conducts the widely recognized 'O', 'A', 'B', and 'C' level courses in computer applications, as well as specialized courses in embedded systems, cybersecurity, and digital marketing. NIELIT operates through a network of accredited centers nationwide, making IT education accessible in tier-2 and tier-3 cities.

records.name: Manipal Institute of Technology
records.description: Manipal Institute of Technology (MIT) Manipal, established in 1957, is one of India's oldest and most reputed private engineering colleges, offering BTech, MTech, and PhD programs across 19 engineering disciplines. It is part of Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE) and is known for its international collaborations, modern infrastructure, and strong placement record. MIT Manipal is particularly recognized for programs in computer science, electronics, mechanical, and biotechnology engineering.

records.name: National Institute of Securities Markets (NISM)
records.description: National Institute of Securities Markets (NISM), established by SEBI in 2006, is India's premier institution for securities market education, research, and certification. It offers post-graduate programs, certification examinations mandatory for securities market professionals, and conducts research on capital markets. NISM's certifications are recognized across the mutual fund, stockbroking, and investment advisory industries as regulatory requirements.

records.name: Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) Institute
records.description: BSE Institute Ltd. (BIL), a wholly owned subsidiary of BSE Ltd. (Bombay Stock Exchange), offers specialized programs in finance, capital markets, and financial services. It provides certificate, diploma, and postgraduate programs in areas such as investment banking, equity research, financial planning, and commodity markets. BSE Institute's location in India's financial capital and its industry connections provide students with unmatched exposure to live markets and finance professionals.

records.name: Indian Institute of Management Lucknow (IIML)
records.description: Indian Institute of Management Lucknow (IIML), established in 1984, is a premier management institution and one of the older IIMs, offering PGP, PGP-ABM, IPMX, and PhD programs. It is known for its agribusiness management program (PGP-ABM), which is among India's best, along with strong offerings in general management, finance, and marketing. IIM Lucknow consistently ranks among India's top five business schools and has strong placement outcomes.

records.name: National Institute of Financial Management (NIFM)
records.description: National Institute of Financial Management (NIFM) Faridabad is an autonomous institution under the Ministry of Finance, Government of India, offering postgraduate programs in financial management for civil servants and professionals. It offers a prestigious Post Graduate Diploma in Management (Financial Management) primarily for Indian Revenue Service officers and a management program for finance professionals. NIFM is a key institution for building financial management capacity within the Indian government.

records.name: Institute of Financial Management and Research (IFMR)
records.description: Institute of Financial Management and Research (IFMR) Chennai, established in 1970, is a leading management institution known for its MBA and research programs with a focus on financial management, development finance, and economics. IFMR Graduate School of Business (now merged with Krea University) is recognized for its rigorous curriculum and strong research culture. The institute has significant contributions to microfinance research and financial inclusion policy in India.

records.name: CFA Institute (India Chapter)
records.description: CFA Institute is the global association of investment professionals that awards the Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) designation, widely regarded as the gold standard qualification in investment management and financial analysis. The India chapter supports a large and growing community of CFA candidates and charterholders across major financial centers including Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, and Chennai. The CFA program covers equity analysis, fixed income, derivatives, portfolio management, and ethics across three rigorous examination levels.

records.name: NID Haryana
records.description: National Institute of Design (NID) Haryana, located in Kurukshetra, is one of the newer campuses under the National Institute of Design network established by the Government of India. It offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs in industrial design, communication design, and textile design. NID Haryana aims to foster design thinking and innovation, serving the design education needs of northern India.

records.name: IDC IIT Bombay
records.description: Industrial Design Centre (IDC) at IIT Bombay, established in 1969, is one of Asia's oldest and most prestigious design schools, offering MDes, BDes, and PhD programs. IDC is known for its interdisciplinary approach integrating engineering, technology, and humanities in design education, with specializations in industrial design, visual communication, interaction design, and animation. It has produced some of India's most influential designers and design educators.
